fields.title: COJ search-result record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Each successful record is one matched entity's search-result row, field names and shapes passed through verbatim from the Companies Office of Jamaica's own register -- extra fields may appear beyond those listed here if upstream adds one.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (name or registration number) that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-companysearch (a matched entity row), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (search matched nothing), blocked_or_transient (network/rate-limit issue), or unexpected_shape (upstream page structure changed).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Result ranking position as returned by the register (0-based).

id.title: Internal record id
id.description: COJ's internal id for this entity, e.g. '61230-L' for a company or '7874_2015-' for a registered business name.

name.title: Entity name
name.description: Registered company or business name, as filed.

number.title: Registration number
number.description: Formatted registration number, e.g. '61230 (Local)', '1057 (Overseas)', or '7874/2015' for a business name.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current register status, e.g. ACTIVE, REMOVED, Registered, In BO Sanction Process.

type.title: Entity type
type.description: COMPANY or BUSINESS (a registered business name / sole proprietorship).

date.title: Registration/incorporation date
date.description: Free-text date as displayed by COJ (not normalized), e.g. '09 Apr 1999'.

address.title: Registered address
address.description: Registered office / business address on file, free-text.

office.title: Officer on file
office.description: A single director/proprietor/shareholder/company secretary name and role, e.g. 'Bjorn Spence - Secretary'. Empty when none is on file for this entity.

documentCount.title: Filed document count
documentCount.description: Number of documents on file for this entity in COJ's system (purchasing them is outside this actor's scope).

link.title: Link
link.description: Reserved by upstream for a direct link; observed empty on every record during testing.
